scope: Four ATOM rear-label masks plus StampFly K138 bounded texture projection; geometry/material data and runtime support are not upgraded.

before.label: paper-labels
before.method: Every source-texture pixel with alpha>=128 is checked at its center against assembled physical triangles transformed into label coordinates. Barycentric orthographic ray/surface intersection; max local-Z gives nearest outward support, without a one-sided-normal assumption. No textured label, UNKNOWN text, live framebuffer or invisible input plane supplies support.

after.label: paper-labels
after.method: Every source-texture pixel with alpha>=128 is checked at its center against assembled physical triangles transformed into label coordinates. Barycentric orthographic ray/surface intersection; max local-Z gives nearest outward support, without a one-sided-normal assumption. sources.notes: Explicit paper-label alpha ROI in original photograph pixels. Case material, surrounding connector bodies and mechanical holes are excluded. Source lighting/perspective remain uncalibrated. Exclude the two source-photo regions occupied by the separately modeled rear female-header housings, including 0.05 mm of display clearance. These rectangles are projected from this model's existing photo-derived header frame geometry; they avoid paper/header overlap without moving the paper, stretching its RGB image, filling a shell opening or claiming calibrated hardware dimensions.
sources.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

remainingLimitations: No new firmware boot or physical-hardware validation.

Real-browser 3D/original-gold-translucent/oblique rendering could not be verified: the integration cloud Chrome could not create a WebGL context. Actual-model geometry and three shell-preset material-isolation checks pass without a WebGL renderer.
Header frames retain their pre-existing photo-derived estimated geometry. The 0.05 mm exclusion clearance is a display choice, not manufacturing tolerance.
Large positive support gaps remain on some model-space paper regions. They are retained as review items rather than filled with invented plastic or blindly trimmed paper bridges.

The independent generic C126 rebuild reproduced the corrected PNG and all pinned source/reference bytes, but not the pre-existing geometry.bin bytes in this local dependency environment. Original geometry is unchanged by this patch; no complete byte-identical CAD rebuild is claimed.
